author: N. Y. Hernandez
title: Six individuals booked into Marshall facilities on June 5
text:
Booking reports indicate that at least six individuals were held at Marshall facilities in Alabama on June 5, 2026.
Charges under the ‘Drug’ category accounted for three entries among the bookings, while ‘Other’ was listed twice and ‘Warrant’ appeared once.
These booking records represent charges recorded at the time of detention. The individuals named have not been found guilty of any charges according to this report.
